description: Cycling Network is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The Toronto bikeways dataset illustrates the existing cycling network across the city, including both shared and dedicated bikeways. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are bicycle lane, bicycle path, bicycle route, bike lane, bike pathway. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
